intro: The classes and check-in pack, for studios, gyms and schools: a week of classes with places and a waiting list, check-in at the door, class packs and teachers' pay. Switch it on in Settings › Industry packs; members book on their plan where the memberships pack is on too.
start: Switch the classes and check-in pack on in Settings › Industry packs.
Add the kinds of class you teach on Class schedule, then the classes themselves.
Make the class packs you sell on Class packs, for people without a plan.
Set each teacher's rate on Teachers' pay, so the month's pay is worked out for you.

articles.title: Put classes on the schedule and book people in
articles.summary: Add the kinds of class you teach, put classes on the week, then book people into them. When a class is full, they join the waiting list.

steps.lead: Press Add a kind of class.
steps.rest: Give it a name, its length in minutes, a drop-in price and the credits a booking takes. Press Add the kind of class.
choose the kind, when it starts and how many places. To repeat it, say for how many weeks. Press Add the class.
from its Actions, and press Add someone.

steps.lead: Choose a customer or enter a member's number,
steps.rest: and how they pay: their plan, a class credit or a drop-in. Press Book the place.
beside someone on the waiting list to offer them a place that has come free.

tips: When someone cancels, the first person waiting is offered the place by email for a short time, then the next.
Cancelling late can keep the credit, as your settings say.
Message all writes to everyone on a class. Cancel the class gives every credit back and tells everyone.

articles.title: Check people in at the door
articles.summary: Scan or type a member in. Their plan or booking is checked, and you see who is in, who is still to come and who was turned away, and why.

steps.rest: on Check-in. The doors open a little before it starts.

steps.lead: Scan their card or fob, or type their member's number,

steps.rest: the reason is shown. To let them in anyway, choose Let in once, give the reason and press Let them in once.

steps.lead: For a walk-in, find the customer
steps.rest: and press Book at the door and check in, while there is a free place.

tips: Someone paying with a credit or a drop-in is checked in from the class list, under Actions.
Those booked who never come are marked no-shows when the class ends.

articles.title: Sell a pack of class credits
articles.summary: A class pack is a number of classes for a price, good for a number of days. Sell one and the customer books with its credits.

steps.rest: the classes in it, the price and how many days it is good for. Press Add the pack.
from the pack's Actions, and choose the customer.
The customer is invoiced, and their credits show under What a customer has left.

tips: A booking takes the credits that run out soonest first.
